ui.agents.detail.meta.delegates.role: Fact in the agent detail's dot-separated meta line
ui.agents.detail.meta.delegates.tone: Plain single word or short phrase, no verb.
ui.agents.detail.meta.delegates.length_hint: One word in English, about 9 characters. It sits between the source label and 'Specialist' on one wrapped line of body-small type; a phrase longer than one word may push the line to two rows.
ui.agents.detail.meta.delegates.note: It states a capability as a fact ('this agent delegates'), not as an instruction; the editable switch elsewhere uses ui.agents.detail.delegate.label, which is a different sentence. Do not translate this as a verb.

ui.agents.detail.read.show_all.role: Link-style expander under prose that the line clamp is cutting
ui.agents.detail.read.show_all.length_hint: About 8 characters in English. The link renders at body-small size in a 48x17.4 px box measured at native; keep it to one short word or two, and keep it the exact antonym of show_less.
ui.agents.detail.read.show_all.note: Toggles the same block between clamped and fully expanded. It appears only when the text actually overflows, so the two labels are read as a pair.

ui.agents.detail.read.show_less.role: The same expander once the prose is expanded
ui.agents.detail.read.show_less.length_hint: About 9 characters in English; same 48 px-tall link box as show_all.
ui.agents.detail.read.show_less.note: Antonym of show_all; a language whose shorter form reads better may reorder the pair only if both stay clearly opposed.
